parse.title: Infinity Castle Tier List (Community)
parse.text:
Information

This page classifies different units to different ranks depending on how good they are in Infinity Castle

Units are ranked based on the following statistics:

  • DPS(Damage Per Second)
  • TDPS(Total Damage Per Second)
  • SPA(Second Per Attack)
  • AoE(Area of Effect)
  • (as well as many other properties of a unit; Cost, Abilities, Effects, etc)

The ranking of each unit is based on how well they preform on each map in infinity castle This tier list ranks units based on their base stats, and their potential including buffs, supports, and relics. This tier list IS BASED ON TRAITLESS UNITS, NOT UNIQUE. Most of the units in the top of each tier happen to be the best for castle with unique as well.
Disclaimer: Given it's a community-based Tier List, any vandalism will be not tolerated and will be given a harsher sentence accordingly.

Stat Rankings

Per-Unit (single) DPS is usually what most people in the community talk about as calculations are easier without taking into account number of placement. Please keep in mind that while certain characters' singular DPS may be higher than others, placement limits affect Total DPS significantly.

DPS accounts for the DMG (Damage) of a unit divided by its SPA (Attack Speed). The Total damage of a unit can be higher or lower as some units can only be placed 3, 4, 5, etc. amount times.

The following info is what is used to describe statistics in the unit descriptions

Lists basic statistics of units and how good they are compared to each other.
DPS SPA Range AoE Size Ranking
<15,000 <5 <25 <8 Low
15,000-25,499 5-8.9 25-34.9 9-14 Average
25,000-34,499 9-12.9 35-44.9 15-20 High
35,000-44,499 13-20 45-49.9 21-30 Extreme
45,000+ 20+ 50+ 31+ Peak
